pitch.title: Deploy on your own servers without the overhead.
pitch.body: From Git to HTTPS with live logs, built to stay out of your server's way.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use the account created during setup.

setup.title: Create the owner account
setup.description: This account manages the server. You can invite your team later.
setup.organizationHint: Usually your company or team name.
setup.tokenHint: Printed by the installer. Run: sudo cat /etc/ferrodock/setup-token

errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.CSRF_ORIGIN_MISMATCH: The request came from an untrusted origin and was blocked.
errors.ROLE_EXCEEDS_MEMBERSHIP: A key cannot have more access than your own role.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: Password must be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.NAME_INVALID: Enter a name up to {{max}} characters.
errors.ORGANIZATION_NAME_INVALID: Enter an organization name up to {{max}} characters.
errors.API_KEY_NAME_INVALID: Enter a key name up to {{max}} characters.
errors.SETUP_ALREADY_COMPLETED: Setup is already complete. Sign in instead.
errors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The database is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.
errors.SETUP_TOKEN_INVALID: The setup token is missing or incorrect. Find it in /etc/ferrodock/setup-token on the server.
